topic: Concerned About Hidden Fees? What to Ask Upfront
objective: Give a practical checklist of fee questions to ask a lender or broker.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Fee structures vary between lenders, but asking the right questions upfront, about establishment fees, ongoing fees, and early repayment costs, removes most of the surprise. A transparent lender or broker will answer these clearly and without hesitation.

slides.headline: Why it matters
bullet_points: Ask about establishment fees before applying
Ask about any ongoing or account-keeping fees
Ask whether early repayment fees apply
Request the total cost, not just the rate

slides.headline: Key things to know
bullet_points: Get fee details in writing, not just verbally
Compare the full offer, not a single figure
A reluctance to answer clearly is worth noting
Read the formal offer document before signing

caption:
Concern about hidden fees is fair, finance agreements can be dense, and it's not always obvious what to ask. A short, direct list of questions usually surfaces everything that matters: establishment costs, ongoing fees, and what happens if you repay early.

A transparent lender or broker won't hesitate to answer these clearly, and the formal offer document should confirm everything discussed.
